precepts.text: In the Babylonian captivity our fathers still made a collection, according to every man's power, not a set amount.
precepts.point: He which soweth sparingly shall reap sparingly, and he which soweth bountifully shall reap bountifully; that does not mean the Most High blesses you with a three story house, for you may be storing up treasures in heaven. Give as you purpose in your heart, not grudgingly or of necessity, for God loveth a cheerful giver; giving with an attitude is worse than keeping the money.

note.label: Exodus 38: The Altar, the Court, and the Sum of the Offering

precepts.why:
In the wilderness the silver came “A bekah for every man, that is, half a shekel”, from every one numbered from twenty years old and upward, “six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.” Thousands of men contributed to the cause of the sanctuary being built. But Israel in the wilderness was delivered, not in captivity.

After Babylon invaded Jerusalem our fathers were captives, yet “they wept, fasted, and prayed before the Lord. They made also a collection of money according to every man’s power”. Not a required amount, but according to every man's power, for the house of the Lord.

Today we are waking up in our captivity, and the buildings we get for sanctuaries require work, wood, service and labor. Likewise the congregations do not push a ten percent; you give according to your power, and the Lord knows how much power you have to give. Sadly some give more than those who have more power to give than they. If you have trouble coming up out of your pocket to help the cause of the Lord, examine yourself whether ye be in the faith, whether you really believe and really study.

moments.label: Awake and Return: Overcoming Babylon's Hypnosis
Making Our Face Harder Than Their Face

points: For we have sinned before the Lord, and disobeyed him, and have not hearkened unto the voice of the Lord our God, to walk in the commandments that he gave us openly. He told us what to do and how to do it, and we have not done it. Everything the churches were talking about at that sit down was a smokescreen for not keeping the Lord's statutes and commandments.

note.label: Awake and Return: Overcoming Babylon's Hypnosis

points: Since the day that the Lord brought our forefathers out of the land of Egypt, unto this present day, we have been disobedient. We got to realize it and admit it.

We have been negligent in not hearing his voice. Definition read in class: negligent means failing to take proper care of someone or something, being overly careless, or ignoring a duty. It's our duty to serve the Lord in righteousness and keep his commandments as it is written. When you repent and come to serve the Lord, you're a prisoner of the Lord now. This is not a game.

note.label: Awake and Return: Overcoming Babylon's Hypnosis

points: Wherefore the evils cleaved unto us, and the curse, which the Lord appointed by Moses his servant. Them plagues and curses cleave unto us, the same ones from Deuteronomy 28:45.

note.label: Awake and Return: Overcoming Babylon's Hypnosis

points: Nevertheless we have not hearkened unto the voice of the Lord our God, according unto all the words of the prophets, whom he sent unto us. He keeps sending us, and we keep coming back saying the same thing to our people, and a lot of our people refuse to come back.

note.label: Awake and Return: Overcoming Babylon's Hypnosis

points: But every man followed the imagination of his own wicked heart, to serve strange gods. They want to keep Thanksgiving, Christmas, the Fourth of July, Presidents Day, their birthday, Valentine's Day, New Year's: all this evil in the sight of the Lord, and they refuse to change their ways. God got a chosen few that he calling in. You can teach in front of a thousand people and maybe twenty stop, but them twenty is the ones he want. We trying to pull a needle out of a haystack when we go out on the front line for our people.

note.label: Awake and Return: Overcoming Babylon's Hypnosis

points: We have not hearkened unto the voice of the Lord our God, according unto all the words of the prophets. That is who is teaching; that is who the Lord uses to project and teach his word, as it is written and exactly as he instructed us to bring it out. So we do not want anyone to be a professional student: once you come into this truth and put on that purple shirt, you go ahead and prophesy and teach the people. Learning the laws is part of getting rid of twenty, thirty, forty years of nonsense; but once you learn it, you have to do something.
